description: This Java source file defines a class LogFragment that represents an Android Fragment containing a LogView for displaying logging data. It manages UI elements such as a ScrollView and LogView, and handles view creation and user interactions.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView for displaying log messages, handling view creation, and auto-scrolling behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets padding, appearance, focusability, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets a TextWatcher on the LogView to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the created view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
